pages.text: $(italic)Tank/Support/Healer. Self-sustaining with group utility. The 'I keep everyone alive' class.$(/italic)$(br2)HP Modifier: +10%  |  Equipment HP: Normal$(br)$(bold)Weapon Affinities:$(/bold) Swords and shields (bonus)

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Holy Aura$(/bold) — Nearby allies within 8 blocks: +5% DR, +1 HP/5s regen. Strongest Paladin aura applies in group.$(br2)$(bold)Divine Resilience$(/bold) — +15% effectiveness from all healing. Self-healing from combat sources +10%.$(br2)$(bold)Consecrated Ground$(/bold) — Standing still 3+ seconds: 4-block Consecrated Ground. Allies: +10% DR. Undead: 2 damage/s.

pages.title: Passive Abilities (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Shield of Faith$(/bold) — 20% of blocked damage converts to heal over 5s. Blocking a killing blow: 30% chance to fully negate it (once per 5 min).$(br2)$(bold)Smite$(/bold) — +20% damage vs undead, demons, void entities. Kills on these emit a 2 HP heal pulse to nearby allies.

pages.title: Active Ability
pages.text: Active: $(bold)Lay on Hands$(/bold)$(br)Instantly heal self or ally for 30% of Paladin's max HP. Removes all negative status effects. Target gains +20% DR for 5s. 90s cooldown.
